en: I haven't showed you guys the update on our apartment.
zh: 我还没给你们看我们公寓的最新进展。

en: So we bought this dining table a week ago.
zh: 我们一周前买了这张餐桌。

en: but I actually don't really like it.
zh: 但其实我不是特别喜欢它。

en: We bought it from Facebook Marketplace.
zh: 我们是在 Facebook Marketplace 上买的。

en: and it was actually in the neighborhood.
zh: 而且卖家其实就在附近。

en: So we basically walked over with it.
zh: 所以我们基本上是直接走过去把它搬回来的。

en: but I just think it's not really nice in this space.
zh: 但我就是觉得它放在这个空间里不太好看。

en: I want a round table.
zh: 我想要一张圆桌。

en: I feel like it's going to be a little bit more inviting.
zh: 我觉得圆桌会让这里看起来更温馨一点。

en: So we're going to switch it out.
zh: 所以我们打算把它换掉。

en: and we also need to buy some dining table chairs.
zh: 然后我们还需要买一些餐椅。

en: We're going to buy a glass sofa table and a little cabinet over here.
zh: 我们打算买一张玻璃沙发边桌，还有这边放一个小柜子。

en: So yeah, Helgi went and picked up a van.
zh: 所以呢，Helgi 去取了一辆面包车。

en: so we can go and pick up all of the furniture pieces.
zh: 这样我们就可以去把所有家具都搬回来。

en: I'm buying them all second-hand.
zh: 这些我全都是买二手的。

en: which is honestly like the best.
zh: 说实话，这真的太棒了。

en: I love buying used furniture.
zh: 我很喜欢买二手家具。

en: I feel like it just has some character.
zh: 我觉得它们就是更有味道一些。

en: Helgi is here in one minute.
zh: Helgi 还有一分钟就到了。

en: So I'm going to put this in a bottle so I can bring it with me okay.
zh: 所以我要把这个倒进瓶子里，这样就可以带着走了，好。

en: Here's the cabinet.
zh: 这就是那个柜子。

en: I am in love with it.
zh: 我真的太喜欢它了。

en: I love these handles and the chestnut wood.
zh: 我很喜欢这些把手，还有这个栗色木质。

en: It's really pretty.
zh: 真的很漂亮。

en: Now we just need to carry it to the van.
zh: 现在我们只需要把它搬到面包车上。

en: Well, we have got everything into the apartment.
zh: 好了，我们已经把所有东西都搬进公寓了。

en: But now we are a little bit skeptical with the sofa table.
zh: 不过现在我们对这张沙发边桌有点犹豫。

en: I mean, I love it.
zh: 我是说，我很喜欢它。

en: but I feel like it's a little bit too big for this sofa
zh: 但我觉得它配这个沙发有点太大了，

en: because it is so low.
zh: 因为这个沙发太低了。

en: And I feel like the sofa table is a little bit too high.
zh: 而且我觉得这张沙发边桌有点太高。

en: So we're actually going to buy another one.
zh: 所以我们其实打算再买一张。

en: that we were planning on buying in the first place.
zh: 也就是我们一开始就打算买的那张。

en: It's actually really close by.
zh: 它其实离这里很近。

en: So even though it's a little bit annoying that we bought this one,
zh: 所以虽然买了这张有点烦，

en: I just think the other one is going to be a little bit nicer.
zh: 但我就是觉得另一张会更合适一点。

en: It's a lot smaller and also lower.
zh: 它小很多，而且也更低。

en: So we're just going to have to sell this one.
zh: 所以我们只能把这张卖掉了。

en: Here's the dining table.
zh: 这就是餐桌。

en: It's like chocolatey brown.
zh: 它是那种巧克力棕色。

en: And now we just need to assemble it.
zh: 现在我们只需要把它组装起来。

en: So we bought these shelves second-hand.
zh: 我们买了这些二手架子。

en: and we realized that we actually wanted to have three.
zh: 然后发现其实我们想要三个。

en: It would look a little bit fuller.
zh: 这样看起来会更饱满一点。

en: Look at this kind of, it's a weird angle.
zh: 你们看这个，有点怪怪的角度。

en: We actually went to IKEA because this shelf is from IKEA.
zh: 我们其实去了宜家，因为这个架子是宜家的。

en: It said on the website that they had it in stock.
zh: 网站上显示还有库存。

en: But they didn't have it.
zh: 但店里并没有。

en: So we actually ended up buying some other things.
zh: 所以最后我们其实买了些别的东西。

en: There's actually a new IKEA in the city, which is really nice.
zh: 城里其实新开了一家宜家，真的挺不错的。

en: And it's our first time going there.
zh: 而且这是我们第一次去那里。

en: We also had some Swedish meatballs for lunch.
zh: 我们午餐还吃了瑞典肉丸。

en: And I didn't record anything because my camera was out of battery.
zh: 我什么都没拍，因为我的相机没电了。

en: So sorry about that.
zh: 所以不好意思啦。

en: But yeah, we bought this carpet.
zh: 不过呢，我们买了这块地毯。

en: And I'm going to show you.
zh: 我来给你们看一下。

en: Wait, look at the back.
zh: 等一下，看后面。

en: So we bought these two vases.
zh: 所以我们买了这两个花瓶。

en: I was like in between the two because this is perfect for like tulips.
zh: 我当时在这两个之间纠结，因为这个特别适合插郁金香。

en: And this is perfect for a bigger bouquet.
zh: 而这个特别适合更大一点的花束。

en: We got some placemats and also in this blue color.
zh: 我们还买了一些餐垫，也是这种蓝色的。

en: I thought it could be cute with the chocolatey brown dining table.
zh: 我觉得配巧克力棕色的餐桌会挺可爱的。

en: Okay. And the rest is just some boring stuff.
zh: 好了，剩下的就是一些没什么意思的东西了。

en: Matilda is having so much fun.
zh: Matilda 玩得可开心了。

en: under the sofa and with a new carpet.
zh: 一会儿钻到沙发底下，一会儿玩新地毯。

en: Oh my gosh.
zh: 我的天啊。
